body_html:
JAMMIN’ DJ’s- Georgia truly helped make the  Tam Wedding a picture-perfect moment at Arrowhead Golf Course in Littleton. The cool evening wedding was complimented by the beautiful environment inside and outside the event center. Everyone came with smiles,laughs, and dancing shoes! From the toasts to the newlyweds, Father-Daughter dance, to the last dance, JAMMIN’ DJ’s was there ensuring the music was perfect the whole night through. Thanks to the  Arrowhead staff for excellent hospitality and communication. On behalf of JAMMIN’ DJ’s, Congratulations to the new Mr. and Mrs. Eric Tam, and to many happy years to come!

DJ Charles
